title: Publication Ledger Schema, Corruption, and Content-Light Closure
released_boundary: PublicationPreviewCanonicalEvidenceLedger: a preview-only publication application-service evidence boundary that persists schema-validated, outcome-complete, recursively content-light, retry-safe append-only preview/refusal events and refuses or explicitly degrades reconstruction on any corrupted evidence.
stated_consumer_purpose: T4 timeline reconstruction and later desktop Publish Preview history can consume publication evidence without silently dropping invalid events or trusting unvalidated ledger records.

dirty_state_after: Same pre-existing files preserved. No other-lane files absorbed into T1.1 commit.

completed_work: Created rig.relay.publication_preview_event.v1.schema.json — event envelope schema with nested receipt validation, required operation_id for idempotency, and all receipt fields validated against the publication preview receipt contract
Added schema validation to append_event(): events are validated against the canonical schema before fcntl fsync, using the same fail-closed pattern as providers/evidence_ledger.py
Added schema validation to load_receipts(): every reconstructed row is validated against the published event schema; invalid rows are rejected from authority
Replaced load_receipts() returning list[dict] with typed LedgerReconstruction: includes corruption_detected, corrupt_lines, corrupt_rows, reconstruction_warnings, and valid_rows

Added authoritative reconstruction mode: load_receipts(authoritative=True) refuses to return any receipts when corruption is detected, preventing consumers from mistaking a partial valid subset for complete canonical evidence

Added recursive content-light enforcement: _scan_recursive() walks nested dicts, lists, and string values checking forbidden field names (conventional), 11 secret/token patterns (regex), and raw-path patterns

Added operation_id-based idempotency: _build_operation_id() creates a stable operation identifier from profile digest + publication policy + refusal state; append_event() checks for existing rows with the same operation_id before appending
Preserved all T1 repairs: receipt digest binding (11 outcome fields), preview_only/deployment_ready guard, refusal evidence binding
Added 23 new production-boundary tests: 3 schema validation, 3 recursive content-light, 3 corruption, 4 idempotency, 2 service integration, 8 upgraded ledger tests
